category_name: 高难任务（容器化，强模型区分）
rednote_relevance: Video/image note pipeline: high-performance pixel-format conversion and scaling (thumbnails, transcoding pre-processing) with SIMD
problem_statement:
Re-implement FFmpeg's libswscale — image scaling and pixel-format conversion — in Zig, as a C-ABI shared library that matches FFmpeg's output quality and beats its C scalar code using portable SIMD. The performance requirement is fully modeled into `/app/perf-check`; optimize for what it reports (single-threaded).

Work in `/app/swscale-impl/` (a starter scaffold is at `/app/scaffold/`); it must build into `libswscale_candidate.so` exporting the three functions in `/app/swscale_api.h`. `/app/perf-check` rebuilds, compares your output against the unmodified reference, and measures both (`--contract` for the full sweep, `--quick` to skip measurement). Correctness is a prerequisite: stay within the accuracy bars on every conversion the contract lists, and one regression is as bad as making no change. `/app/README.md` has the full contract (formats, algorithms, accuracy bars, commands); FFmpeg's sources are at `/reference/ffmpeg-src/`.

Confine your changes to `/app/swscale-impl/`, and write the conversions yourself — no inline assembly, and do not wrap, link, load or embed FFmpeg or any part of it. This sandbox times out after a fixed amount of time — check it with `sandbox-timer --help`. Ensure to keep the workspace updated and in working condition even in case the sandbox times out. The machine is offline; everything you need is already present.

environment.initial_state: image /app: scaffold, perf-check, driver, reference .so; FFmpeg sources at /reference/ffmpeg-src
environment.udocker_execmode_note: proot (P1): FrontierSWE's grader builds/measures as the non-root 'agent' user (runuser + setuid). udocker R1 (rootless runc) maps only uid 0, so user switching fails there.

verification.reward: continuous in [0, 1] = correctness x (2^clamp((s-1)/19, 0, 1) - 1), s = geomean work ratio reference/submission over held-out workloads (callgrind + per-opcode pricing); 0 if it does not build, links/wraps FFmpeg, or any conversion misses the PSNR bars
verification.pass_threshold_note: pass = reward >= 0.1 (correct everywhere and ~3.6x less work); mean score over trials is the primary metric

gold_solution.note: FrontierSWE ships no reference implementation (oracle_reward_threshold = 0): solve.sh installs a placeholder converter that reaches every verifier phase (build, provenance, contract sweep, measurement) and scores 0.0 by design. Validate via reward_details (build_ok, provenance_ok, correctness, measured).

source.original_scoring: continuous reward, Mean@5 over 5 runs (site reports normalized meanFrac)
conversion_changes: instruction, environment, tests and oracle copied verbatim; images pinned by digest
agent budget 7200s instead of 72000s (20h); TASK_BUDGET_SECS set to match so the agent-visible sandbox-timer is consistent
agent runs as fake root under udocker (original: non-root `agent`); /root is an empty per-trial dir so verifier assets stay hidden
verifier runs in a disposable container from the verifier image with the /app artifacts copied in (Harbor environment_mode=separate)

discrimination.what_it_measures: Long-horizon systems/SIMD engineering against a strict correctness contract (58 conversions, PSNR bars) and a deterministic cost model
discrimination.caveat: reference scores were obtained with a 20h budget; scores under the 2h budget here are not directly comparable
